what: Salary coverage of one real Bronze run, measured with ingestion/land_to_bronze.extract_salary before deploying it
method: Structured fields only: Ashby compensation.summaryComponents (Salary), Lever salaryRange, Greenhouse pay-range block in content HTML. Free text is not parsed. Bronze rows before dedup.

implausible_ranges.rule: salary_max > 4 x salary_min (source typos such as $152,405 - $179,300,152)

notes: Greenhouse usually titles the block 'Pay Range' without a period, so salary_interval stays NULL instead of being guessed
